How did public school students break down by race and ethnicity in 2024-25?

SELECT race_ethnicity, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(student_count AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which technologies have the lowest projected levelised cost of electricity in 2030, moderate scenario?

SELECT technology_alias, round(min(try_cast(value AS double)), 1) AS lcoe_per_mwh FROM govblock_energy.oedi_atb_atbe WHERE core_metric_parameter = 'LCOE' AND scenario = 'Moderate' AND core_metric_variable = '2030' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many contract actions in fiscal year 2025 were set aside for service-disabled veteran-owned businesses?
SELECT count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND type_of_set_aside LIKE '%SERVICE-DISABLED%'
How are insiders related to the companies whose stock they report?
SELECT rptowner_relationship, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_reportingowner GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people riding bicycles died in traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS cyclists_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '6' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022'
Which hospitals treated the most Medicare patients for sepsis in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_org_name AS hospital, rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double)) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_desc LIKE 'SEPTICEMIA%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of coal-fired units reported a wet limestone scrubber in 2023?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN so2_controls LIKE '%Wet Limestone%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.campd_facility_attributes WHERE year = 2023 AND primary_fuel_type LIKE 'Coal%'
Which states have the largest share of adults with a bachelor's degree or higher?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E022' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END) + max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E023' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END) + max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E024' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END) + max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E025' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B15003_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_bachelors_plus FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b15003' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was California's unemployment rate in April 2020?
SELECT year, period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LASST060000000000003' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period = 'M04'
Which agencies run the most federal assistance programs?
SELECT federal_agency_030, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_assistance_listings WHERE federal_agency_030 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many contributions from political committees to candidates were made in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_fec.contributions_to_candidates WHERE transaction_dt LIKE '%2020'
Which states are divided into the most counties or county equivalents?
SELECT usps AS state, count(DISTINCT geoid) AS counties FROM govblock_census.gazetteer_gaz_counties GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of active community water systems are privately owned?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN owner_type_code = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
From which countries did the United States import the most passenger cars in 2024?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.gen_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_imports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '8703%' AND d.year = '2024' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many reactors reported running at full power on New Year's Day 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS reactors FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE (reportdt LIKE '1/1/2020 %' OR reportdt LIKE '01/01/2020 %') AND try_cast(power AS double) = 100
Which large cities have the highest share of residents born abroad?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E003' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B05012_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_foreign_born FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '1600000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b05012' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was New York's highest hourly electricity demand in 2022?
SELECT max(try_cast(demand_mw AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'NYIS' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2022'
What did vehicles hit first in the most fatal crashes of 2022?
SELECT harm_evname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of transmission line segments run underground?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN type LIKE '%UNDERGROUND%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines
Which ERCOT settlement points show the highest average real-time price in the records?
Ercot Lmp By Settlement Point Cdr Lmpsrosnodenp

SELECT settlementpoint, avg(try_cast(lmp AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.ercot_lmp_by_settlement_point_cdr_lmpsrosnodenp WHERE settlementpoint IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the peak hourly load on Long Island in July 2019?
SELECT max(try_cast(integrated_load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_zonal_load_hourly_palintegrated WHERE name = 'LONGIL' AND time_stamp LIKE '07/%/2019%'
Which states lost the most pedestrians to traffic crashes in 2022?
SELECT statename, count(*) AS pedestrians_killed FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE per_typ = '5' AND inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many device reports in 2023 described a death?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event WHERE event_type = 'Death' AND date_received LIKE '2023%'
Which states oversee the most active public water systems?
SELECT primacy_agency_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND primacy_agency_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem bioassays were deposited by ChEMBL?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2depositorname WHERE depositorname = 'ChEMBL'
In which states are long-stay nursing home residents given antipsychotic drugs most often?

SELECT provider_state, avg(try_cast(four_quarter_average_score AS double)) AS avg_percent FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_qualitymsr_mds WHERE resident_type = 'Long Stay' AND measure_description LIKE '%antipsychotic%' AND provider_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many CPSC recalls concern children's products or toys?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE lower(title) LIKE '%child%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%toy%'
Which models have the most complaints that involved a crash?
SELECT concat(maketxt, ' ', modeltxt) AS model, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE crash = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average size of a federal sub-award?
SELECT avg(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search
Which public schools had the largest enrolments in 2024-25?

SELECT sch_name, st, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many small molecules does GDB-11 enumerate?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb11
Which drug and device companies paid doctors and teaching hospitals the most in 2023?

SELECT applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_making_payment_name, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospitals filed Medicare cost reports for fiscal year 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp10_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '2024'
Which New York public schools have the most students?

SELECT sch_name, try_cast(student_count AS double) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' AND st = 'NY' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What did Medicare pay on average for a hip or knee replacement without complications in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_payment FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_cd = '470'
Which wind farms in Iowa have the largest number of turbines?
SELECT p_name, count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'IA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of adverse drug event reports change from 2010 to 2020?
SELECT substr(receivedate, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_event WHERE substr(receivedate, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2020') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which organisations own the most U.S. patents of all time?

SELECT disambig_assignee_organization AS organisation, count(DISTINCT patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated WHERE disambig_assignee_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many proposed rules did the Environmental Protection Agency publish in 2021?
SELECT count(*) AS proposed_rules FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE agency LIKE '%ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY%' AND doc_type = '"PRORULE"' AND issue_date LIKE '"2021-%'
Which counties have the most private hospital jobs?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.area_title, try_cast(q.annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_area_titles AS t ON t.area_fips = q.area_fips WHERE q.agglvl_code = '75' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.industry_code = '622' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did the number of documents posted to Regulations.gov change from 2010 to 2024?

SELECT substr(replace(posteddate, '"', ''), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_documents WHERE substr(replace(posteddate, '"', ''), 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states have the most statute sections in force?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE document_type = 'statute' AND act_status = 'in_force' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many awards were funded with COVID-19 relief money?
SELECT sum(try_cast(award_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_covid_faba_spending WHERE spending_level = 'subtier_agency'
Which companies list the most drug products with the FDA?
SELECT labeler_name, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_drug_ndc WHERE labeler_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many voting-age citizens live in the Bronx?
SELECT try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE geoname = 'Bronx County, New York' AND lntitle = 'Total'
